column3: “Eat to the mountains” is rendered “eat at the mountain shrines.”
“Interest and interest” is rendered “interest or take increase,” and “justice of faithfulness” as “true justice.”
“Alas” follows a doubtful word; NASB has “to a brother.” The meaning is uncertain.
NASB puts the first half in parentheses.
“From the poor” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “from iniquity.” NASB keeps “from the poor.”
“Borne in the iniquity” is rendered “bear the punishment for … iniquity.”
“Borne in the iniquity” is rendered “bear the punishment for … iniquity.”
